exposure: prevention program for mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of HIV infection
late usage of MTCT prevention service
outcome: rate of MTCT of HIV infection
risk of HIV infection in exposed infants
cohort: The study included 545 mother-infant pairs whose medical records were reviewed at the Olabisi Onabanjo University Teaching Hospital.
finding: The rate of MTCT of HIV infection was 2.9%, which was lowest among mother-infant pairs who received prophylaxis, with late usage of the MTCT prevention service and ages at recruitment identified as risk factors for infection.
cross-section timing: Medical records reviewed over a 12-year period
